about: NOT INSTALLED (removed after round 2, 2026-11-10). vercel-labs/agent-desktop 1.2.0 (npm, unsigned native x64 binary). Logon task agent-desktop-bridge runs C:\vmlab\stdio-tcp-bridge.ps1 in the desktop session: one `agent-desktop mcp` per connection on the VM's 127.0.0.1:8010; the host bridges stdio with ssh -W (vm-mcp-tcp).
